senses.en: too proud of yourself; vain

example.en: He is so conceited that he never listens to advice.
example.zh: 他太自负了，从不听劝告。

senses.en: not necessary; able to be done without

example.en: The manager felt the extra report was dispensable.
example.zh: 经理觉得那份额外的报告可有可无。

senses.en: a person who believes that pleasure is the most important thing in life

example.en: As a hedonist, he spent his days eating well and relaxing.
example.zh: 作为一个享乐主义者，他把日子都花在美食和休闲上。

senses.en: a serious illness caused by exposure to excessive heat

example.en: Athletes training in hot weather risk heatstroke.
example.zh: 在炎热天气下训练的运动员有中暑的风险。

senses.en: warm, comfortable and pleasant

example.en: The little room felt very cosy with a fire burning.
example.zh: 炉火烧着，这个小房间感觉非常温暖舒适。

senses.en: a padded cover used to keep a teapot warm

example.en: She made a woollen tea cosy for the teapot.
example.zh: 她给茶壶做了一个毛线保暖套。

senses.en: a telephone service that offers help and advice to callers

example.en: Call the helpline if you have any questions about the form.
example.zh: 如果你对表格有任何疑问，请拨打热线电话。

senses.en: wood from broad-leaved trees such as oak or maple, usually dense and strong

example.en: The floor was made of polished hardwood.
example.zh: 地板由抛光的硬木制成。

senses.en: the highest natural adult male singing voice

example.en: He sings tenor in the church choir.
example.zh: 他在教堂唱诗班里唱男高音。

senses.en: the general meaning or main idea of something

example.en: The general tenor of his speech was hopeful.
example.zh: 他演讲的总体基调是充满希望的。

senses.en: feeling dizzy or lightheaded

example.en: She felt giddy after spinning around many times.
example.zh: 她转了很多圈后感到头晕。

senses.en: silly and not serious

example.en: He was in a giddy mood all afternoon.
example.zh: 他整个下午都情绪轻快兴奋。

senses.en: Unfair treatment of a person or group because of prejudice.
senses.zh: 基于偏见对个人或群体的不公平对待。

example.en: The law prohibits discrimination in hiring.
example.zh: 法律禁止在招聘中进行歧视。

senses.en: The ability to recognize differences or make careful distinctions.
senses.zh: 辨别差异或作出细致区分的能力。

example.en: Good discrimination between fact and opinion is essential.
example.zh: 善于区分事实与观点至关重要。

senses.en: The mental process of distinguishing between two or more things.
senses.zh: 区分两种或多种事物的心理过程。

example.en: The study examined how children develop color discrimination.
example.zh: 该研究考察儿童如何发展颜色辨别能力。

senses.en: the use of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry
senses.zh: 科学技术在实际用途中的应用，尤指工业技术

example.en: Modern technology has changed how people communicate.
example.zh: 现代技术改变了人们的沟通方式。

senses.en: machines and equipment developed from scientific knowledge
senses.zh: 由科学知识发展而来的机器设备；技术产品

example.en: The hospital invested in new medical technology.
example.zh: 这家医院投资购买了新的医疗技术设备。

senses.en: a particular method or system based on scientific knowledge
senses.zh: 基于科学知识的特定方法或工艺

example.en: Farmers are adopting water-saving technology.
example.zh: 农民正在采用节水技术。

senses.en: A helpful or positive effect.

example.en: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
example.zh: 经常锻炼对健康有很多好处。

senses.en: Money or help provided by a government or employer.

example.en: The company offers benefits such as health insurance.
example.zh: 公司提供医疗保险等福利。

senses.en: To help somebody or improve a situation; (benefit from/by something) to gain an advantage or help from something.
senses.zh: 有益于；使受益；（benefit from/by）受益

example.en: The new road will benefit the whole community.
example.zh: 这条新路将惠及整个社区。

senses.en: to come together in one place

example.en: A crowd gathered outside the station.
example.zh: 一群人聚集在车站外。

senses.en: to collect things or information from different places

example.en: She gathered the papers from the table.
example.zh: 她把桌上的文件收拢起来。

senses.en: to understand or believe something from what you have heard

example.en: I gather that you are leaving soon.
example.zh: 我猜想你很快就要离开了。

collocations: as far as I can gather

senses.en: to make someone able to do something or make something possible

example.en: The scholarship enabled her to study abroad.
example.zh: 奖学金使她能够出国留学。

senses.en: to make a device or feature active or available, especially in computing

example.en: You can enable notifications in the app settings.
example.zh: 你可以在应用设置中启用通知。

senses.en: a channel along the edge of a roof that carries away rainwater

example.en: Leaves were blocking the gutter on the roof.
example.zh: 树叶堵住了屋顶的檐槽。

senses.en: a channel at the side of a street that carries away rainwater

example.en: Rainwater ran down the street into the gutter.
example.zh: 雨水沿街道流进了排水沟。

senses.en: to burn unsteadily or flicker weakly (of a flame or candle)

example.en: The candle guttered in the wind.
example.zh: 烛光在风中摇曳不定。

senses.en: the space between columns of text or facing pages in printing or publishing
senses.zh: （排版中的）栏间空白；（书页的）装订线

example.en: Adjust the gutter so the text isn't lost near the binding.
example.zh: 调整装订线间距，以免文字在装订处被遮住。

senses.en: to make something or someone unable to work or function
senses.zh: 使失去能力；使不能正常运作

example.en: A virus disabled the computer system.
example.zh: 一种病毒使计算机系统无法运行。

senses.en: to turn off a function or setting

example.en: You can disable notifications in the settings.
example.zh: 你可以在设置中禁用通知。

senses.en: to make things follow the same standard or rules

example.en: The company standardized its safety procedures across all factories.
example.zh: 公司将其所有工厂的安全流程标准化了。

senses.en: the number 11; one more than ten

example.en: She will turn eleven next month.
example.zh: 她下个月满十一岁。

senses.en: a team of eleven players, especially in football (soccer) or cricket
senses.zh: 十一人球队；（尤指足球、板球的）一支球队

example.en: The local eleven won the match easily.
example.zh: 当地的十一人球队轻松赢得了比赛。

senses.en: the right of a country or region to govern itself

example.en: The region was granted greater autonomy by the central government.
example.zh: 中央政府给予了该地区更大的自治权。

senses.en: the ability to make one's own decisions independently

example.en: Employees value autonomy in how they organize their work.
example.zh: 员工重视在工作安排上的自主性。

senses.en: public support for an idea, cause, or policy

example.en: Her advocacy for animal rights has influenced local policy.
example.zh: 她倡导动物权利，影响了当地政策。

senses.en: the act of pleading or arguing on behalf of another, especially in law

example.en: Effective advocacy in court requires careful preparation.
example.zh: 在法庭上有效辩护需要充分的准备。

senses.en: the process by which a wound or the body becomes healthy again

example.en: Proper rest is important for the healing of a broken bone.
example.zh: 充分休息对骨折的愈合很重要。

senses.en: having a restorative or soothing effect

example.en: Many people find music to be a healing experience.
example.zh: 许多人觉得音乐是一种治愈的体验。

senses.en: the act of shedding tears, often with sobs

example.en: I could hear crying from the next room.
example.zh: 我能听到隔壁房间传来的哭声。

senses.en: very urgent and needing attention

example.en: There is a crying need for more affordable housing.
example.zh: 人们迫切需要更多经济适用房。

senses.en: likely to happen very soon

example.en: There were warnings that a storm was imminent.
example.zh: 有警告称暴风雨即将来临。

senses.en: the headgear put on a horse, including the bit and reins, used to control it

example.en: She adjusted the bridle before leading the horse out of the stable.
example.zh: 她调整好马勒，然后把马牵出马厩。

senses.en: to show anger or offense, often by drawing the head back stiffly
senses.zh: 发怒；（因恼怒而）昂首作怒

example.en: He bridled at the suggestion that he had made a mistake.
example.zh: 听到暗示他犯了错，他勃然大怒。

senses.en: to put a bridle on a horse

example.en: The groom bridled the horse before the ride.
example.zh: 马夫在骑乘前给马套上了马勒。

senses.en: located next to or near something

example.en: We visited a neighbouring town for the weekend.
example.zh: 我们周末去了一个邻近的城镇。

senses.en: a round object used in games and sports

example.en: He kicked the ball over the fence.
example.zh: 他把球踢过了围栏。

senses.en: a round or spherical shape of something

example.en: The cat rolled itself into a ball.
example.zh: 猫把自己蜷成一团。

senses.en: a large formal dance party

example.en: She wore a beautiful gown to the ball.
example.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的礼服去参加舞会。

senses.en: to form something into a round shape by rolling or squeezing

example.en: He balled up the paper and threw it away.
example.zh: 他把纸揉成团扔掉了。

senses.en: a person who hunts wild animals

example.en: The hunter waited quietly in the forest.
example.zh: 猎人安静地在森林里等候。

senses.en: a person or animal that searches for and catches something

example.en: Owls are skilled night hunters.
example.zh: 猫头鹰是技艺高超的夜间捕食者。

senses.en: a sudden wild rush of frightened animals or a crowd of people

example.en: A loud noise started a stampede among the cattle.
example.zh: 一声巨响惊得牛群狂奔起来。

senses.en: to cause animals or people to run in panic, or to rush in panic

example.en: The crowd stampeded toward the exits.
example.zh: 人群蜂拥着冲向出口。

senses.en: to kill someone without a legal trial, usually by a mob

example.en: The mob lynched the accused man before the trial began.
example.zh: 暴民在审判开始前私刑处死了被告。

senses.en: to loosen or remove something by turning it

example.en: She unscrewed the cap of the bottle.
example.zh: 她拧开了瓶盖。

senses.en: a large bird of prey that feeds on dead animals

example.en: Vultures circled above the plain.
example.zh: 秃鹫在平原上空盘旋。

senses.en: a person who preys on others' misfortune for gain

example.en: Vultures circled the struggling company, hoping to profit from its collapse.
example.zh: 贪婪的投机者盯着这家苦苦挣扎的公司，指望从其倒闭中牟利。

senses.en: cozy and comfortable, like a home

example.en: The little cafe has a homey atmosphere.
example.zh: 这家小咖啡馆有一种温馨如家的氛围。

senses.en: the upper layer of earth where plants grow

example.en: The soil here is rich and dark.
example.zh: 这里的土壤肥沃而黝黑。

senses.en: to make something dirty

example.en: The puppy soiled the carpet.
example.zh: 小狗弄脏了地毯。

senses.en: land or territory, especially of a country

example.en: The troops set foot on foreign soil.
example.zh: 军队踏上了外国领土。

senses.en: a round vegetable with brown or yellow skin that grows underground

example.en: She peeled the potatoes for dinner.
example.zh: 她削了土豆皮准备晚饭。

senses.en: a small soft red fruit that grows on a bush

example.en: She picked a handful of ripe raspberries.
example.zh: 她摘了一把成熟的树莓。

senses.en: a rude sound made by putting the tongue between the lips and blowing

example.en: The boy blew a raspberry at the referee.
example.zh: 那个男孩对着裁判咂舌起哄。

senses.en: dark red or purplish red in colour

example.en: She wore a raspberry dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条深红紫色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: a boat that carries people or vehicles across water

example.en: We took the ferry across the river.
example.zh: 我们乘渡轮过河。

senses.en: to carry people or vehicles by boat across water

example.en: The boat ferries passengers to the island.
example.zh: 这艘船把乘客渡运到岛上。

senses.en: to carry someone or something regularly between places

example.en: A bus ferries workers to the factory.
example.zh: 一辆公交车把工人运送到工厂。

senses.en: faithful support for a person, group, country, or cause

example.en: Her loyalty to her friends never wavered.
example.zh: 她对朋友的忠诚从未动摇。

senses.en: the way something is arranged or presented

example.en: The report follows a clear format.
example.zh: 这份报告采用清晰的格式。

senses.en: to arrange or prepare something according to a particular style or system

example.en: She formatted the essay according to the guidelines.
example.zh: 她按照指南格式化了这篇文章。

senses.en: a standard structure for storing or handling data

example.en: This image format is not supported.
example.zh: 不支持这种图像格式。

senses.en: to prepare a storage device for use by setting up its file system

example.en: He formatted the new drive before use.
example.zh: 他在使用前格式化了新硬盘。

senses.en: relating to geography or the physical features of an area

example.en: The two countries are separated by a geographical boundary.
example.zh: 这两个国家被一条地理分界线隔开。

senses.en: logical and consistently connected; easy to follow

example.en: She gave a coherent explanation of the plan.
example.zh: 她对计划作了条理清晰的解释。

senses.en: able to think and express oneself clearly
senses.zh: （说话）清楚明白的，思路清晰的

example.en: He was barely coherent after the long flight.
example.zh: 长途飞行后他几乎语无伦次。

senses.en: a feeling of thankfulness for kindness or help received

example.en: She expressed her gratitude to everyone who helped her move.
example.zh: 她向每一位帮她搬家的人表达了感激之情。

senses.en: to move smoothly and effortlessly

example.en: The swan glided across the lake.
example.zh: 天鹅滑过湖面。

senses.en: a smooth, continuous movement

example.en: The plane made a silent glide down to the runway.
example.zh: 飞机无声地滑降到跑道上。

senses.en: a speech sound that slides into another, like the y in yes

example.en: The sound /w/ in 'win' is a glide.
example.zh: 'win' 中的 /w/ 是一个滑音。

senses.en: the time when the sun first appears above the horizon in the morning

example.en: We got up early to watch the sunrise over the sea.
example.zh: 我们早起去观看海上的日出。

senses.en: relating to a new and growing industry or technology
senses.zh: 新兴的（常指产业或技术）

example.en: Solar power is often described as a sunrise industry.
example.zh: 太阳能常被称为新兴产业。

senses.en: to criticize severely or condemn

example.en: The critics damned the movie for its weak plot.
example.zh: 评论家们因情节薄弱而严厉批评这部电影。

senses.en: used to express anger or annoyance

example.en: Damn! I forgot my keys again.
example.zh: 该死！我又忘带钥匙了。

senses.en: used informally for emphasis, showing annoyance
senses.zh: 该死的；讨厌的（用于强调）

example.en: I can't find this damn file anywhere.
example.zh: 我到处都找不到这个该死的文件。

senses.en: extremely; very (informal)

example.en: The exam was damn difficult.
example.zh: 这场考试非常难。

senses.en: dried stalks of grain crops, used for animal bedding, fodder, or weaving

example.en: The farmer spread fresh straw in the barn for the animals.
example.zh: 农夫在谷仓里为牲畜铺了新鲜稻草。

senses.en: a thin tube used for drinking

example.en: She stirred her juice with a straw.
example.zh: 她用吸管搅拌果汁。

senses.en: following one after another without interruption

example.en: It rained for five consecutive days.
example.zh: 雨连续下了五天。

senses.en: a person who pays rent to live in or use a building or land owned by someone else

example.en: The tenant pays the rent on the first of every month.
example.zh: 房客每月一号交房租。

senses.en: the state of expecting or hoping that something will happen

example.en: The children waited with expectancy for the show to begin.
example.zh: 孩子们满怀期待地等着演出开始。

senses.en: the length of time something is expected to last, e.g. a person's life

example.en: Life expectancy has risen steadily in many countries.
example.zh: 许多国家的人均预期寿命持续上升。

senses.en: a group of countries or parties that act together for a common purpose
senses.zh: 集团；（国家或政党的）联盟

example.en: Several nations formed a trade bloc.
example.zh: 多个国家组建了一个贸易集团。

senses.en: something added to food to improve its flavor, such as salt or spices

example.en: Add a little seasoning to the soup before serving it.
example.zh: 上桌前往汤里加一点调味料。

senses.en: to formally give up a right, title, or claim

example.en: The prince renounced his claim to the throne.
example.zh: 王子放弃了对王位的继承权。

senses.en: to publicly state that you no longer believe in or support something
senses.zh: 宣布放弃，宣布与…断绝关系

example.en: She renounced her former political beliefs.
example.zh: 她公开宣布放弃以前的政治信仰。

senses.en: a tiny speck, especially of dust

example.en: Motes of dust danced in the sunlight.
example.zh: 阳光中飘舞着微尘。

senses.en: a small fault in someone else compared with a larger one of one's own

example.en: He noticed the mote in his brother's eye but ignored his own faults.
example.zh: 他看见兄弟的小毛病，却无视自己的大缺点。

senses.en: made in sections in a factory to be assembled on site

example.en: They live in a prefabricated house built in the 1950s.
example.zh: 他们住在一座建于20世纪50年代的预制房屋里。

senses.en: requiring great strength or effort
senses.zh: 艰巨的；需付出巨大努力的

example.en: Cleaning up after the flood was a herculean task.
example.zh: 洪水后的清理工作是一项艰巨的任务。

senses.en: having or showing great strength

example.en: He was a man of herculean strength.
example.zh: 他是个力大无穷的人。

senses.en: of or typical of Western countries (Europe and the Americas)

example.en: Some occidental customs seem unfamiliar to visitors from Asia.
example.zh: 一些西方习俗对来自亚洲的游客来说显得陌生。

senses.en: a person from a Western country

example.en: The café attracted both occidentals and locals.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆吸引了西方人和当地人。

senses.en: to make someone lose courage or feel discouraged

example.en: The huge mountain did not daunt the climbers.
example.zh: 高耸的大山没有吓住登山者。

senses.en: a person who lives in a city

example.en: As an urbanite, she found the quiet countryside strange at first.
example.zh: 作为城市居民，她起初觉得安静的乡村很陌生。

senses.en: able to be got or acquired

example.en: Tickets are still obtainable from the box office.
example.zh: 票仍可在售票处买到。

senses.en: wanting or wishing for something

example.en: He is desirous of a better position at work.
example.zh: 他渴望工作中有一个更好的职位。

senses.en: an artist who paints or draws portraits

example.en: The portraitist captured the queen's calm expression beautifully.
example.zh: 这位肖像画家把女王平静的神情画得惟妙惟肖。

senses.en: to prove a claim with evidence or facts

example.en: The report must be substantiated with reliable data.
example.zh: 这份报告必须用可靠的数据加以证实。

senses.en: currently holding a title or position, especially in sports or competitions

example.en: She is the reigning champion in women's tennis.
example.zh: 她是现任女子网球冠军。

senses.en: exercising power as a ruler

example.en: The reigning king opened the new parliament building.
example.zh: 在位的国王为新议会大楼揭幕。

senses.en: a musician or singer who performs alone or as the featured performer

example.en: The soloist received a standing ovation after the concerto.
example.zh: 协奏曲结束后，独奏者赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

senses.en: a slight shade of a color

example.en: The sky had a pink tint at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空带着粉红色调。

senses.en: to give something a slight color

example.en: The artist tinted the walls a soft yellow.
example.zh: 画家把墙刷成了柔和的黄色。

senses.en: a small, very sharp knife used by surgeons in operations

example.en: The surgeon picked up a scalpel.
example.zh: 外科医生拿起一把手术刀。

senses.en: a person who catches animals, usually in traps for their fur

example.en: The trapper spent the winter in the mountains.
example.zh: 那个捕兽人在山里度过了冬天。

senses.en: places where trains or buses stop for passengers

example.en: Several railway stations were closed for repairs.
example.zh: 几座火车站因维修而关闭。

senses.en: buildings or posts where people are assigned to work, such as police or fire stations

example.en: Fire stations responded quickly to the alarm.
example.zh: 各消防站迅速响应警报。

senses.en: the section of an orchestra that plays stringed instruments

example.en: The strings played softly while the flute carried the melody.
example.zh: 长笛奏出旋律时，弦乐组轻柔地伴奏。

senses.en: special conditions attached to an agreement (usually plural)

example.en: The loan came with strings attached.
example.zh: 这笔贷款附带条件。

senses.en: unfilled positions or available spaces

example.en: The hotel still has vacancies for this weekend.
example.zh: 这家酒店本周末仍有空房。
